title: Input Symbol After Configuration Update
statement: Let $m$ be a natural number, let $x$ be a finite bit string, and let $\Lambda$ be a type. Given any configuration $c$ for input $x$ with $m$ work tapes, any state $s\in\Lambda$, any input-head position $ip$ among the $|x|+2$ positions, any work-tape index $r<m$, and any integer position $p$, the updated configuration reads the same input symbol as the symbol at position $ip$ in $x$, with the two boundary positions interpreted as blank.
